special_teams.long_snapper_rule: Cain retains the starting point and snaps first; Kreiter gets real game operation. returners.rule: No returner is named before the game. Westhoff establishes the game rotation from the players who actually took return work in camp. The camp record states that several players fielded punts in the catch work, at the scrimmage's changes of possession and in the August 5 return-decision period without naming them; the only named return work on the 2014 record is Taylor Gabriel's return-path and communication work at the May 16 and 17 rookie minicamp. No name is invented here; the game receipt names who fields each kick.
returners.note: One long return does not automatically decide the job.

special_teams.head_coach_decisions: Fourth down, field goal versus go, fake, onside kick, timeout, challenge and unusual end-of-half situations remain Stone's. No preseason fake just to put it on film.
